cc:Work.dc:title: Calibration: probability versus observed frequency
cc:Work.dc:description: Ten equal-width probability bins; labels show bin counts n. Empty bins are omitted. Diagonal indicates exact calibration. 95% Wilson binomial intervals are unadjusted for repeated-team/group dependence; no recalibration is fitted to test outcomes.
